name: Kayle
title: the Righteous

Q.name: Radiant Blast
Q.description: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.5×AP + 0.6×bonus AD magic damage, Slowing by 25/30/35/40/45% for 2 seconds, and removing 15% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds from the target and enemies behind them.
Q.summary: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

W.name: Celestial Blessing
W.description: Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring 55/80/105/130/155 + 0.25×AP Health and granting 0.24/0.28/0.32/0.36/0.4 + 0.001×AP Move Speed for 2 seconds.
W.summary: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.

E.name: Starfire Spellblade
E.description: Passive: Attacks deal an additional 15/20/25/30/35 + 0.2×AP + 0.1×bonus AD magic damage. Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional (8/8.5/9/9.5/10 + 0.015×AP) × 0.01 missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level @Spell.KaylePassive:LevelForPassiveRank2@, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
E.summary: Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks. Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.

R.name: Divine Judgment
R.description: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for 2.5 seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing 200/300/400 + 0.7×AP + 1×bonus AD magic damage to nearby enemies.
R.summary: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

Passive.name: Divine Ascent
Passive.description: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Kayle is a scaling hybrid who starts as a weak melee fighter and becomes a ranged powerhouse as she levels. She plays top, survives the early game, and protects allies with Divine Judgment.
strengths: Huge late-game scaling: gains range and waves of fire as she levels.
Divine Judgment makes an ally invulnerable.
Radiant Blast slows and shreds armor and magic resist.
Celestial Blessing heals and gives move speed.
Starfire Spellblade adds magic damage to every attack.
weaknesses: Very weak early: melee range and low damage until her passive gives range.
No escape apart from W move speed.
Needs many levels to become strong, so a lost lane hurts her badly.
Easily bullied by ranged and early-game top laners.
Squishy late, so she relies on Divine Judgment to survive dives.

curve.lvl1: weak – melee range and low damage, easy to bully
curve.lvl2: weak – Q slow helps escape, but she still can't trade
curve.lvl3: weak – W heal and speed help survive, not fight
curve.lvl6: okay – Divine Judgment saves an ally or herself; her range grows with levels
curve.items: strong – first item: Nashor's Tooth and Rabadon's Deathcap

profile.curveNote: Kayle is weak early and gets stronger with levels. Her real power is late.
profile.waveClear: Good after levels: waves of fire.
